# Verbs

What events, automatic moves and operations do. A verb is stored by its key.

| Verb | Key | Group | Meaning | Named by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Promote | `promote` | move | Move the object forward to a next state of its lifecycle. | event `archive` |
| Demote | `demote` | move | Move the object back to an earlier state of its lifecycle. |  |
| Override | `override` | move | Make a move although its conditions or signatures are not met. |  |
| Set state | `set-state` | move | Put the object in a chosen state directly, without a declared move. |  |
| Sign | `sign` | signature | Give a signature that a move needs. |  |
| Reject | `reject` | signature | Refuse a signature, so the move does not happen. |  |
| Ignore | `ignore` | signature | Waive a signature, so the move no longer waits for it. |  |
| Withdraw | `withdraw` | signature | Take back a signature already given. |  |
| Delegate | `delegate` | signature | Hand a signature or a task to another actor. |  |
| Route | `route` | signature | Send the object to actors for review, signature or a task. |  |
| Claim | `claim` | task | Take a task offered to several actors, so only you hold it. |  |
| Complete | `complete` | task | Finish a task. |  |
| Create | `create` | object | Make a new object. |  |
| Read | `read` | object | See an object or a link, and its data. | right `SalaryHrOnly` |
| Modify | `modify` | object | Change the values of an object or a link. | event `edit`, right `SalaryHrOnly`, right `NameHrOnly` |
| Delete | `delete` | object | Remove an object. |  |
| Copy | `copy` | object | Make a new object from an existing one. |  |
| Revise | `revise` | object | Make the next revision of an object. |  |
| Lock | `lock` | object | Reserve an object, so only the actor holding the lock may change it. |  |
| Unlock | `unlock` | object | Release a lock. |  |
| Change owner | `change-owner` | object | Give an object another owner. | right `OwnerKeptWhileFrozen` |
| Change type | `change-type` | object | Make an object an instance of another type. |  |
| Change lifecycle | `change-lifecycle` | object | Put an object under another lifecycle. |  |
| Freeze | `freeze` | object | Make an object or a link read-only until it is thawed. While frozen it can't be modified, connected, disconnected or deleted. | event `freezeRecord` |
| Thaw | `thaw` | object | Undo a freeze. | event `thawRecord` |
| Connect | `connect` | link | Link two objects through a relation. |  |
| Disconnect | `disconnect` | link | Remove a link between two objects. |  |
